name: 2007 livery
description: White fuselage over a dark-blue belly that runs from behind the radome to a rounded end ahead of the tail; 'DELTA' in widely spaced navy capitals with the red widget ahead of it over the forward windows; the fin navy with the widget drawn large and faceted in two reds, cut by a navy Y. Navy engines. 'DELTA' and the widget again in white under the belly.

B712.note: The nacelles are white, the fuselage's paint, with a polished lip, not the navy of the Airbus and 737 cowlings (N953AT 2023-04-16, N992AT 2023-07-31).

notes: Drawn from A321neos in 2025 (N572DT left, N583DT from below). The navy belly is narrow from the side and broad from below. The widget's facets on the fin are traced from the left side; the fleet number on the fin tip and the registration are not drawn. 'Delta' isn't on the engines. Re-checked 2026-11-15 on N572DT (A321neo, Delta's commonest family): the title runs x 0.176-0.278 (about 4.5 m); the belly's edge drawn as the curve it is. No measured A321 shape yet, so no fitted check. On the shorter A320/737-800 the same title covers a larger share. On the 717 the nacelles are white, the fuselage's paint, with a polished lip (N953AT 2023-04-16, N992AT 2023-07-31: sources 3 and 4), not navy: drawn so on the 717's shape (`types.B712`). On the 717 'DELTA' and the widget sit a little further aft and run about 4.3 m (N953AT), as on the A321neo in metres, so the shares here draw them a little short there; left as measured. Fin re-measured 2026-11-26 on N572DT (A321neo, left, 2025-02-01) fitted to shapes/A21N.json and read in fin space: the upper facet reaches the leading edge (it had stopped short), the shaded facet meets the root at x 0.53-0.715 and the lower-right one at 0.8 (both had been drawn 0.06-0.09 aft), the navy Y's stem between them (the edges carried on a little past the root, as the paint runs onto the fairing). The fin's widget logo entry is gone: the areas are the widget, cropped by the fin's edges, and a widget mark centred on the fin drew a second, wrong triangle over them.
history: Replaces Skyarium v1's approximate standard (a few colors from memory). The 2007 livery replaced the 'colors in motion' scheme (2000–2007) and was carried onto the Northwest fleet after the 2008 merger.
